sloka: उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम् ।सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयं रथकुटुम्बिना ।। ६.१०६.२० ।।
transliteration: upayānāpayāne ca sthānaṁ pratyapasarpaṇam ।sarvametadrathasthena jñeyaṁ rathakuṭumbinā ।। 6.106.20 ।।

translations.english: "To hold the chariot or advance, to go near the (enemy) or retreat, to return back or advance, everything should be known to the charioteer."
